name: calorie-tracker
description: Offline calorie, macro and water tracker for South Indian and Saudi/Gulf food.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
